other.label: Other
other.step1: In your calendar, look for “Subscribe”, “Share” or “iCal address” and copy the address

google.step1: Do this on a computer: open calendar.google.com in the browser. It does not work on a phone, the Google Calendar app does not show the address
google.step2: On the left under “Settings for my calendars”, tap your calendar
google.step3: Scroll down to “Integrate calendar” → copy the “Secret address in iCal format”. Do not make the calendar public

icloud.step1: iPhone: Calendar app → “Calendars” at the bottom → tap ⓘ next to the calendar

outlook.step1: Under “Publish a calendar”, pick your calendar and “Can view all details” → Publish

import.confirmUnsubscribe: End the subscription? The mirrored calendar and its events disappear from Yorik; nothing changes at the source.
import.title: Bring over a calendar (Google, iCloud, Outlook …)
import.subscribeIntro: Yorik mirrors the calendar and syncs it every 15 minutes. It is read-only here: you keep adding events in Google, and they then show up in Yorik, on the family board and in search. Nothing goes from Yorik to Google.
import.pasteHere: Paste it here. The address is secret; Yorik stores it encrypted.
import.publicAddress: This is the public address. It only works while the calendar is open to everyone on the internet. Take the “Secret address in iCal format” instead and switch public sharing off again in Google.
import.fileIntro: For moving over: the events land in one of your calendars and belong to you afterwards (edit, move, delete). Importing the same file again doesn't create duplicates. In Google: Settings → “Import & export” → Export; the ZIP file contains one .ics per calendar.
